# Trust Swap — Swap Tokens Inside a Self-Custody Wallet Reference

> Swap ETH, USDC and tokens directly inside a self-custody wallet across EVM chains — Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum — through an in-wallet DEX aggregator. You keep your keys and seed phrase. Independent, not affiliated with Trust Wallet.

## Key Facts
- Trust Swap here = swapping tokens directly inside a self-custody wallet (a Trust Wallet–style in-wallet DEX aggregator) across EVM chains
- Custody: non-custodial — you keep your own keys and seed phrase; the wallet signs every transaction
- Network: runs on the EVM chain you select (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, etc.); each swap stays on one chain
- Gas: paid in each chain's native coin (ETH on Ethereum/Arbitrum, BNB on BNB Chain, POL on Polygon)
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (native coin) + price impact; ERC-20 spend needs a one-time approval
- Common pairs: native coin <-> USDC / USDT and other tokens with on-chain liquidity
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Trust Wallet, and NOT the separate TrustSwap project
